question: As per April 2025 announcement, CRPF decided to raise which battalion for counter terror operation in Jammu and Kashmir?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CoBRA Battalion**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **CoBRA Battalion**, also known as **Commando Battalion for Resolute Action**, is a specialized force within the **Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF)**.
 
• It was established in **2009** to tackle **insurgency and counter-terrorism** operations, particularly against **Naxalite threats**.
 
• This battalion is trained in **guerrilla warfare** and **jungle warfare tactics**, making it highly effective in challenging terrains.
 
• The decision to raise a CoBRA unit in **Jammu and Kashmir** is aimed at addressing the **increased terrorist activities** and ensuring **peace and security** in the region.
 
• The battalion is equipped with **state-of-the-art weapons** and technology to execute operations with **precision and efficiency**.
 
• CoBRA units have played a significant role in combating insurgents in various parts of India, including **Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Odisha, and Bihar**.
 
• Their deployment in **Jammu and Kashmir** highlights the Indian government's focus on strengthening **anti-terrorist operations**.
 
• CoBRA personnel undergo rigorous training in **improvised explosive device (IED) detection**, **specialized weapons handling**, and **quick response techniques**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Garud Commando Force**__

 __
 
• The **Garud Commando Force** is the **special forces unit of the Indian Air Force (IAF).**
 
• They are primarily tasked with **protecting IAF bases**, conducting **airborne operations**, and undertaking **special missions** related to the IAF.
 
• The unit was established in **2004** after the Kargil War to enhance the security of Indian Air Force stations.
 
 
 
• **Special Frontier Force (SFF)**__
 __
 
• The **Special Frontier Force (SFF)**, also known as **Establishment 22**, is a paramilitary unit operating under the Indian Army.
 
• It was formed in **1962** and primarily consists of personnel of **Tibetan origin**.
 
• The SFF specializes in **mountain warfare** and has been involved in various covert operations.
 
 
 
• **Para (Special Forces)**__
 
 
• The **Para (Special Forces)** is a unit of the **Indian Army** and is one of the oldest and most prestigious special forces in India.
 
• It specializes in **direct action, hostage rescue, counter-terrorism, and unconventional warfare.**
 
• Their motto is "**Men apart, every man an emperor**."
